import sys, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp/tests')
import altbuild
from ref import Image, Bad, top
for seed in range(1,8):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    prefixes=set(); seen=set()
    for _ in range(80):
        ln=rng.choice([0,1,6,7,12,16,17,24,48,64,65,96,120,128])

    try:
        img=altbuild.build_image(pl,rng)
        Image(img)
        continue
    except Bad as e:
        print(seed,'invalid:',e)
        reg=0x7295e4299901c0400000000000000000
        for ln in range(16,-1,-1):
            k=(ln, top(reg,ln))
            hit=[p for p in pl if (p[0],p[2])==k]
